summary: Kennedy Lewis Capital Company filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026 reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary KLCC SPV GS1 LLC entered into a Third Amendment to its First Amended and Restated Credit Agreement on September 28, 2026. The amendment raises the secured facility financing limit from $500 million to $550 million, extends the reinvestment period from May 1, 2028 to September 28, 2029, extends the scheduled maturity from May 1, 2030 to September 28, 2031, and lowers the borrowing spread to 2.25%. A related non-recourse carveout guaranty amendment was executed. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation.
